Container.Name: immich-autotag
Container.Overview:
Immich AutoTag is a powerful automated rule engine for Immich. It automates batch photo and video organization: automatically creates and assigns albums, applies smart tags, fixes broken or future EXIF dates, applies user permissions, and organizes legacy photo imports based on flexible declarative YAML rules.
The :cron image runs scheduled periodic processing in the background according to CRON_SCHEDULE (default: hourly).
Template maintained by repires; immich-autotag is developed by txemi (GPL-3.0).
Container.Requires: An active Immich server and an Immich API key created in Immich under Account Settings -> API Keys.

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: Directory containing config.yaml and rule definitions.

Config.Name: Logs Directory
Config.Description: Directory where execution logs are written.

Config.Name: Cron Schedule
Config.Description: Cron expression defining when AutoTag runs (default: '0 * * * *' runs every hour on the hour; '*/15 * * * *' runs every 15 min).
